change1: - Added: Tasker 6.4.6 Beta is now fully supported (i.e. Widget V2 support).
change2: - Added: Additional Profile Properties added to the output: Limit Repeats, Cooldown Time, Profile Variable Type.
change3: - Added: Re-instituted the progress bar in the Map and Diagram views.
change4: - Added: 'Profiles Per Line' option added to the Diagram view.  Click on the '?' next to it for details.
change5: - Added: Ollama models 'qwen2.5' and 'qwen2.5-coder' have been added.
change7: - Changed: 'Go to top' and 'Go to bottom' hotlinks have been removed from the Map view in preference to the 'Top' and 'Bottom' buttons.  'Go to top' is still in the browser output.
change8: - Changed: The popup window displaying 'The view is running in the background.  Please stand by...' has been eliminated for improved performance.
change10: - Fixed: Spacing for '[Continue Task After Error]' is incorrect in the Map view.
change11: - Fixed: Diagram view is missing an occasional Task underneath it's Profile.
change12: - Fixed: Eliminated potential 'Rutroh!...' output in the terminal.
change13: - Fixed: The log file is not being generated if 'Debug' is turned on in the GUI.
change14: - Fixed: Selecting a single named item in the GUI doesn't clear out the other single named items in the pulldown selection menus.
change15: - Fixed: Program terminates abnormally if the Map or Diagram buttons are double-clicked.
change16: - Fixed: 'Bottom Task' button points to the bottom Task's arrow rather than to the Task itself.
change18: - An upgrade to Tcl-tk version 9 (brew install tcl-tk) may cause an error when importing tkinter.  If this occurs, refer to the README.
change19: - Task actions that are specific to Android 15 have not yet been mapped, and will display as such.
change20: - Open Issue: The background color may not be correct if using the Firefox browser in light mode if the system default is dark mode.
change21: - Open Issue: The Map view Project/Profile/Task/Scene names with icons are not displaying correctly in the Map view if using highlighting (underline, etc.).
